messages.subject: INLA64.exe Termination Error
parts:
Hi,

I am using R inla to run a spatial model but every time I run the model,  inla64.exe stops working. Can this be caused by limited space (RAM) in my computer.

I have tried to upgrade the programme but still it's crashing.

Thanks,
